subject: Extract shared de-identification contract module
description: Remove the reverse dependency that would force the teammate deidentifier to import scripts/process_vlm.py. Move DeidentificationFrameReport, DeidentificationOutcome, and the callable protocol/type into a small import-safe AI module such as ai/vlm/deidentification_contracts.py. Have process_vlm import the shared contract. Keep implementation absent and fail closed. Update tests/imports, run python -m pytest tests/test_vlm*.py -q plus compileall and git diff --check, then commit excluding .gjc and record evidence.
